labelling_rule: Rule A: Y only if the MAIN entity on most rows is a non-government business. Registers of individuals (advisers, auditors, credit reps) are N even when a company appears as a secondary party. Government bodies are N. In contract/invoice data the supplier is the entity (the government buyer is ignored). Licensed clubs counted Y; a foundation-run childcare register counted N (reviewer judged foundations not businesses).
